title: 有馬記念の後に・キーワードを集めよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's fishing banner flies high as proof of her victory over Eishin Flash in the Arima Kinen. As promised, a new clue from the Book of Secrets is hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It says Eden is at the bottom of the ocean and can only be reached after defeating four powerful opponents and collecting four clues. The whole thing is extremely fishy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Who wrote the Book of Secrets? And where did it come from? No answers are available, but the only path left is forward. Eden awaits you, Gold Ship! Most likely, anyway!
